description: Monitor ONE local business over time: create a persistent baseline, then detect only new public Google reviews, rating changes, website AI-readiness regressions and meaningful score changes. Use when you need historical change detection and optional JSON webhook alerts for one known business. Use local_presence_audit instead for a one-off full audit; use review_radar instead when you only need new-review alerts without website monitoring. Auth: Apify API token required in Authorization: Bearer. Rate limits: 60 calls/min/IP on this facade; results capped at 100 items per call, no pagination. Side effect: when webhookUrl is set and dryRun is false, high-severity changes trigger an HTTPS JSON POST; dryRun never calls the webhook and skips Actor event charges, while Apify platform and proxy usage can still apply. Pricing: $0.25 per run + $0.25 per business monitored + $0.10 per delivered alert.

dryRun.description: Run the full monitoring workflow but skip pay-per-event charges and webhook delivery. Apify compute and proxy usage can still apply.
dryRun.title: Dry run without event charges or webhook delivery

language.description: Two-letter Google Maps interface language such as fr, en or de.
language.title: Google Maps interface language

maxReviews.description: Number of recent public Google reviews to compare with persistent state, from 1 to 30.
maxReviews.title: Maximum recent reviews

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy used only when query is set. Datacenter is the low-cost default; RESIDENTIAL is optional and billed separately.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

query.description: Optional business name and city used to find the Google Maps profile. Leave empty for website-only monitoring with no Google proxy usage.
query.title: Business search query

ratingDropThreshold.description: Create a high-severity alert when the public Google rating falls by at least this amount, for example 0.2 stars.
ratingDropThreshold.title: Rating-drop alert threshold

scoreDropThreshold.description: Create a high-severity alert when the presence score falls by at least this many points.
scoreDropThreshold.title: Score-drop alert threshold

webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint receiving a JSON POST for high-severity changes. Never called during dryRun.
webhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL

websiteUrl.description: Public website URL monitored for JSON-LD, metadata, llms.txt and AI-crawler robots.txt signals.
websiteUrl.title: Business website URL

name: local_presence_monitor
